questions.prompt: Which alert in a Tier-1 queue escalates to Tier 2?

options.b: a confirmed compromise, multi-host scope, credential compromise, or one needing containment authority

questions.prompt: A brute force that SUCCEEDED against a service account on a server is:

options.b: a confirmed credential compromise — tp AND escalate

questions.prompt: Escalating every TP instead of only those meeting the triggers:

options.b: floods Tier 2 and devalues real escalations
